title: Application factory
interface: create_app(overrides: dict | None = None) -> Flask. app = Flask(__name__, template_folder=<absolute path to the repository's templates/ directory, i.e. Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'templates'>, static_folder=<repository static/>). app.config.update(load_config(overrides)). Register blueprints: auth bp (src/auth/oidc.py), admin bp (src/web/admin.py), employee bp (src/web/employee.py, no prefix), and the three API blueprints at url_prefix '/api/v1'. app.teardown_appcontext(close_db). GET /health -> {'status': 'ok'}. Context processor injecting `user` = current_user() and `config` = app.config into templates. Do NOT create a module-level app; provide `if __name__ == '__main__': create_app().run()`.

uses.blueprints: src/auth/oidc.py bp; src/web/admin.py bp; src/web/employee.py bp; src/api/assets.py bp; src/api/employees.py bp; src/api/handovers.py bp

database: app.config['DATABASE'] is the single source of truth
